data.narrative:
Heaviside is a Series A defense and security company founded by Phillip Walker that has raised $28M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 companies: 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms in the same sector and stage, including Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, and NODA AI.

Stage-progression methodology was not applicable; the last posted valuation base of $600M, when stepped up by the typical 2.0x Series A multiplier, implied a $1.2B valuation—more than 20x total capital raised—indicating unreliable input data. The peer-median approach yielded the sole reliable triangulation. Four same-sector, same-stage comparables produced a median valuation of $700M, with a range spanning $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence). This wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in defense-tech market positioning and investor appetite.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $595M to $805M, centered at $700M. Key uncertainties include the performance differentiation of Heaviside relative to outlier peers—particularly the $4.0B Stark Defence valuation—and the applicability of defense sector peers to Heaviside's specific technology and customer set. The single-method triangulation limits conviction; additional revenue or growth-rate data would strengthen precision.
